# Look recipes: starting formulas, not law

Companion to `/visual-aesthetics`. Each recipe names the palette, light, camera, motion and finish that make the look read; tune every number by capture. Most lean dark-field because emissive light is TD's home turf, but do not DEFAULT to a glowing accent in a dark void; that is its own cliche. If the brief allows daylight, paper, pastel or fog, take the high-key route. Without a skills folder, fetch it as `get_guidance(topic='visual-aesthetics/look-recipes')`.

- **High-key editorial**: bright, slightly tinted field (0.92-0.97, never pure white); a DARK subject carries the read, so the value logic inverts and the deepest dark sits on the subject; separation via soft shadows (`soft2d`) and value, not glow; NO bloom; minimal grain (2-4%); one small saturated accent. A light frame reads premium next to the dark-field default.
- **Neon glow lines**: near-black field (0.02-0.05); line or edge content in 1-2 neon hues with white-hot cores; additive composites; Bloom carries the glow (threshold ~0.7, modest intensity); motion is slow drift plus an occasional pulse; finish with vignette and grain. The accent IS the light source.
- **Filmic 3D scene**: PBR plus Environment Light (low `dimmer`) plus a three-point rig; camera fog (`fog=exp`) tinted to the background; lens chosen for the mood (long is calm, wide is drama); DOF via Depth into Luma Blur; grade, Tone Map `acesapprox`, restrained Bloom; ember-on-teal or deep-sea palette.
- **Organic feedback painting**: Feedback TOP loop with a Level inside it (`opacity` 0.90-0.98 as decay) and a slight Transform (scale 1.001-1.01, rotate 0.05-0.3); inject a small moving seed shape; palette Lookup OUTSIDE the loop (grading inside compounds every frame). Bound it per `performance.md`: fixed resolution, decay below 1, reset wired. Slow, breathing motion.
- **Particle nebula**: instanced sprites or POP particles; Point Sprite MAT, additive, low per-sprite brightness; speed-mapped color through a deep-sea or neon ramp; Bloom carries the glow; slow camera orbit plus handheld micro-noise; vignette and grain.
- **Pastel gradient field**: large soft Ramp gradients plus low-contrast shaped noise, displaced slowly (Displace TOP); pastel-dawn palette; NO pure black or pure white anywhere; minutes-slow drift; slightly heavier grain (6-10%) keeps the softness from banding; no bloom.
- **Monochrome architectural**: hard geometry, one cone key with `soft2d` shadow, near-mono palette (optional acid accent on ONE element); highest value contrast on the subject; long lens; film grain; generous negative space.
- **Data / HUD graphic**: Constant MAT flats plus Line MAT structure over a dark field; ONE accent color for the live or important channel; grid-aligned typography via Text TOP (Text TOP renders text into TOP chains; Text COMP is for panel UI only); motion is eased state changes, no ambient wiggle; crisp AA; no bloom, no grain.
